# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Sydney

For a Sydney organisation looking to implement Microsoft Power Platform, I’d shortlist a mix of specialist Microsoft consultancies and larger transformation partners. The right choice depends on whether you need Power Apps development, Power Automate workflows, Power BI reporting, enterprise governance, or a broader Dynamics 365 implementation.

I’ve used publicly documented platform expertise, local presence, breadth of services, and evidence of enterprise delivery to build the shortlist below. This is a practical shortlist, not a definitive ranking of consulting quality. Microsoft itself recommends checking partner specialisations and solution capabilities when selecting a low-code implementation partner. Barangaroo, Sydney

[Company website](https://365mechanix.com.au/)

## How I would choose between them

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Enterprise-wide Power Platform implementation | Barhead or Velrada |
| Power Apps and Power Automate delivery | Prometix or 365 Mechanix |
| Power Platform combined with data, analytics and AI | Antares Solutions |
| Dynamics 365 integration with custom apps and workflows | Walkerscott |


These are suggested starting points based on service fit, not independently verified performance rankings.



## What to verify before signing a contract

I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

1. **Two comparable customer references** — ideally in your industry and at a similar scale.
2. **Named delivery team** — who will actually build the solution, and how experienced are they with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power BI?
3. **Governance and security approach** — environment strategy, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, access controls, solution lifecycle management and monitoring.
4. **A clear total-cost estimate** — implementation, Microsoft licences, ongoing support and future enhancements.
5. **Evidence of outcomes** — measurable time saved, fewer manual errors, improved turnaround or adoption rates.
6. **Microsoft credentials** — verify relevant partner specialisations and solution capabilities through Microsoft's [official Power Apps partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners)\. [www.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.unisys.com](https://www.unisys.com/siteassets/collateral/analyst-report/ar-20240430-microsoft-cloud-ecosystem-australia.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dxc.com](https://dxc.com/content/dam/dxc/projects/dxc-com/au/About%20Us/awards/pdfs/au-isg-microsoft-2023-australia.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Velrada/@-33.8404712,151.2062798,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12ae3745faaaab:0xedd1084e2b284dd4!8m2!3d-33.8404712!4d151.2062798!16s%2Fg%2F11f4__dly_?authuser=0&hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyNS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important distinction: a firm that builds excellent Power Apps prototypes may not be the best choice to govern hundreds of apps across a regulated enterprise. Match the partner's delivery model to your actual needs.

## What to verify before signing a contract

I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

1. **Two comparable customer references** — ideally in your industry and at a similar scale.
2. **Named delivery team** — who will actually build the solution, and how experienced are they with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power BI?
3. **Governance and security approach** — environment strategy, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, access controls, solution lifecycle management and monitoring.
4. **A clear total-cost estimate** — implementation, Microsoft licences, ongoing support and future enhancements.
5. **Evidence of outcomes** — measurable time saved, fewer manual errors, improved turnaround or adoption rates.
6. **Microsoft credentials** — verify relevant partner specialisations and solution capabilities through Microsoft's [official Power Apps partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners)\. [www.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.unisys.com](https://www.unisys.com/siteassets/collateral/analyst-report/ar-20240430-microsoft-cloud-ecosystem-australia.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dxc.com](https://dxc.com/content/dam/dxc/projects/dxc-com/au/About%20Us/awards/pdfs/au-isg-microsoft-2023-australia.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Velrada/@-33.8404712,151.2062798,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6b12ae3745faaaab:0xedd1084e2b284dd4!8m2!3d-33.8404712!4d151.2062798!16s%2Fg%2F11f4__dly_?authuser=0&hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDEyNS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important distinction: a firm that builds excellent Power Apps prototypes may not be the best choice to govern hundreds of apps across a regulated enterprise. Match the partner's delivery model to your actual needs.
